script_text: Vault Notes, vaultnotes-7. This is an after-run replay of a lab exam, not a live attack. The agent LLM for this run was glm-5.3:cloud. 8 agents produced 2258 events over a 1501-second window. Each row is one agent; each column is a stage, from human on the left to publish on the right. Most activity was in the proven-gate stage, with 2141 events. The first publish came 148 seconds in. Coverage: 15 endpoints, 18 findings, 0 verified. Nearby dots are not proof that the agents coordinated.
